content: Tada drashtuh svarupe avasthanam. (Then the Seer abides in its own true, untouched nature).
author: Patanjali
explanation: When the mind ceases to project distorted interpretations, consciousness rests in its own primordial, unbound essence (*Purusha*) rather than identifying with mental states.
practicalInsight: Step back from the position of the thinker to that of the impartial seer. Observe your thoughts today as passing clouds in the sky of awareness.
reflectionPrompt: Who is the one observing these thoughts right now?
